Description begins with 'Adds', not 'Returns', so @return must not be dropped per the @return redundancy rule. The return semantics are present but they are inlined as a second sentence ('Returns `true` if ...') instead of a `@return` tag. Preferred form: keep the first sentence as-is and move the return semantics to `@return true if successfully enqueued; false if already enqueued or not registered with a queue`.
